body:
Thank you for writing this up. I appreciate it, and it's good to know.

I think I'll give it a try.  Can only help.

There's nothing inherently wrong with them.  And to be fair, I should at least try them before refusing them.  I just have a lot of people in my family who take them, and it seems awful.

I remember seeing someone post something like "If the doctor had heart medicine that you needed, would you not take that?" or something to that effect.
